evals.prompt: Be the steward. What should run next?
evals.expected_output: Reads the program profile, latest handoff, decisions ledger and register first; starts a facts ledger; opens with the profile's metric read from the data store; classifies remaining work as session-ready / needs decomposition / human-only; returns a session plan as owner · lane · scope · acceptance · risk plus what is blocked and why; does not pick which session runs.

evals.prompt: Charter a session for the database owner to add the new table the design memo calls for.
evals.expected_output: Runs the grounded prompt review before writing: opens the memo and the schema, checks whether a structure to extend already exists, reads the register for triggered entries and inlines them, names the connection path for any apply or fences it to STAGED. Produces the fixed-shape charter with first line '<Owner>: <task>' and READ FIRST / DELIVER / RUN / HARD FENCE / REPORT. Children told not to edit ledgers, merge, or spawn a steward.

evals.prompt: PR #42 is up from the search owner. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Steward review re-runs the gates itself; identifies touched shared surfaces and dispatches blind independent seats proportionally; one consolidated synthesis with every deferral drafted as a register entry; adjudication as a conversation with recorded dispositions; one fix round; merges only if delegation is recorded in the profile, otherwise hands the merge to the principal.

evals.prompt: The principal hasn't said whether we can go multi-region. Just decide and move on.
evals.expected_output: Declines to invent the ruling: records a candidate in the decisions ledger with the question, options, evidence and recommendation; fences dependent work out of scope; lists it under 'what you must decide' in the brief. Proceeds with everything that does not depend on it.

evals.prompt: I'm done for the day. Hand off.
evals.expected_output: Writes the handoff doc (facts ledger, landed, in flight with session ids, next build, roadblocks, decisions owed, fences, sessions to archive) and a launch prompt built from the committed template with slots filled; batches ledger updates into one end-of-session PR; arms no recurring loop.
